name: Send App
verdict: Remittance platform of Flutterwave, a payments technology company. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of Nairobi City Thunder on a two-season deal from the 2026 campaign. Send App's parent is Flutterwave (claim). Flutterwave is venture-backed; its named investors (TechCrunch, Feb 2022) are venture capital and private firms with no state or state fund among them, and no human-rights finding against the company itself was found.
